title: Festival of San Fermín 2026
description: The 2026 Festival of San Fermín in Pamplona, Spain, features the famous running of the bulls, traditional processions, and festive gatherings from 6 to 14 July.

title: Holi 2026
description: Holi 2026, the Festival of Colors, marks the arrival of spring in India and beyond with joyful gatherings, vibrant powdered dyes, music, and the triumph of good over evil.

title: Diwali 2026
description: Diwali 2026, the Festival of Lights, celebrates the victory of light over darkness with oil lamps, rangoli patterns, family gatherings, and fireworks across India and the global diaspora.

title: Swedish Midsommar 2026
description: Swedish Midsommar 2026 marks the traditional Midsummer celebration with maypoles, floral crowns, outdoor dances, and gatherings under the long Nordic summer light around the solstice.

title: World Goth Day 2026
description: World Goth Day 2026 is an international celebration of goth subculture, encompassing its distinctive music, fashion, art, and community expression observed each year on 22 May.
